convert_img: convert a (H, W, C) numpy image array to (C, H, W) channel-first format
create_ClipToTensor: create a ClipToTensor transform that converts a list of video frame numpy arrays to a normalized torch tensor of shape (C, T, H, W)
create_ClipToTensor_K: create a ClipToTensor_K transform that converts video frames to a torch tensor normalized to the range [-1, 1]
create_ToTensor: create a ToTensor transform that converts a numpy array directly to a torch tensor without normalization
test_ClipToTensor_call: test ClipToTensor by passing a list of numpy image arrays and verifying the output tensor shape and range
